policy: MoE sparse context: keep only a tiny stable resident surface; load officers, skills, source files, and ledgers on demand; preserve evidence by handle instead of replay.

resident.reason: small runtime overlay for cache and routing policy

on_demand.reason: Go deterministic base is loaded by symbol, range, or command need only
test evidence is loaded by failing block or named case
expert mirrors activate only after routing

cold_ledger.reason: truth source is referenced by hash unless kernel editing is the task
atom decisions are queried by handle or key
checklists enter only during audits and closeout
inventory ledger enters only during cleanup/audit
cleanup charter enters only during fusion/purity work
runtime token evidence enters only as hash, metrics, and pass/fail
fresh-thread seed is used only when current outer context is already bloated
